scope: Bounded B01/B06 diagnosis; not formal capacity acceptance and not historical 504 attribution

mac_lock_sites.instrumentation: Fixed per-call-site successful-lock counters incremented while holding the one HTTP Task-driver mutex; no per-lock clocks, no hot-path output; atexit emits one bounded counter vector. N4 includes a 1-second native sample. Not performance acceptance.

environment.affinity_scope: The platform exposes no sched_getaffinity; owner thread placement is not established.
environment.quota_scope: Native macOS has no Linux cgroup quota. Logical contexts can include performance/efficiency clusters; placement, frequency and other host work are not controlled.
environment.capacity_bound_scope: Upper bound from visible logical CPUs, affinity and quotas; the Go client, Python observer and sampler subprocesses share it with the native service. It is not a count of equivalent dedicated performance cores.

client_cpu.source: POSIX wait4 exact terminated process lifetime
client_cpu.scope: Includes Go startup, measurement and finite cleanup; not restricted to the Go measurement window.
client_cpu.max_rss_raw_units: bytes on macOS, KiB on Linux; platform raw value retained

server_delta.window_scope: Before/after control observations include process launch, client measurement, bounded cleanup and observation gaps; they are not the exact Go measurement window.
server_delta.counter_scope: requests counts complete business bodies before UTF-8/admission; response counters count prepared responses, not confirmed client delivery. All concurrent traffic on this private service is included.

task_driver_timing.scope: Delta cumulative totals; max_* remain lifetime maxima and cannot be subtracted into phase maxima.

sampler_thread.scope: Observer thread CPU only, excluding waited ps/lsof subprocesses; a subset of Python process CPU.

observer_cost.max_rss_scope: RUSAGE_SELF ru_maxrss is the Python process lifetime high-water mark, not this phase's incremental peak; bytes on macOS, KiB on Linux.
observer_cost.scope: Python process CPU includes its main and observer threads. RUSAGE_CHILDREN delta includes reaped Go and ps/lsof tools; subtracting exact wait4 Go CPU leaves tools plus any other concurrently reaped children. Live/unreaped children and unrelated host processes are excluded. The sampler thread CPU is a subset of Python CPU, never added twice.

observation_windows.meaning: Use the event counter's own outer observation wall as its CPU denominator. The Go throughput window is separate; dividing outer-window event CPU by configured Go duration can overstate core use. Observer CPU includes metadata, startup, sampling and finite cleanup costs.

reconciliation.scope: Signed differences retain network/observation boundaries. A successful client write is not evidence of server reception; concurrent nonclient traffic is also in server deltas.

ledger.server_received_note: Collect before/after server complete-request counters separately; connect/write success does not prove server reception.

This quantum must remain non-scalar and reconcile. The computation loop itself is scalar and skips on all 767904 observed pure yields.
interpretation.child_wait_guard_scope: 192 child-slot / wait-driver / explicit-intent observations occur during the two digits awaits for 96 completed requests. None blocks the preceding integer computation loop.
